title: Moving fire survivors off FEMA interim housing
summary: As of August 31, the County is meeting with FEMA on how caseworkers can meet together with residents at the Kīlohana housing site, and an official said not everyone living there will be eligible to stay. A clinician said patients worry FEMA will make them leave at month's end. The site is moving from a federal to a county facility, and more than 1,100 households remain in temporary housing, with the gap lasting until 2030.
